rationale: The original long continuation premise has weakened: price broke the 48.60 support area and is trading below the 9-EMA at 48.49, with the latest five 1-minute candles showing persistent lower highs and lower lows. The position is still above the formal invalidation level, but the short-term setup no longer justifies holding, and a flip short is unattractive against the large gap-up, high relative volume, and wide spread.
